From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenfield Health — recap from today's call and next steps

Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared accountability: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: patient data summarization + clinician-facing conversational assist, moderate RPS, strict retention & audit requirements.
- Decision criteria: security posture, predictable latency, cost per request, and ease of integration with existing EHR.
- Timeline: procurement + security review in Apr, pilot in May, wider rollout in Q3.

Action items / asks (our side)
1) I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary we can share with your security team (SOC2-summary.pdf) — this is a high-level extract; full report available via secure link when you confirm NDA routing.
2) Marissa will send our short security playbook and the pen-test scope template you can review.
3) Can you please share the primary procurement contact and any vendor questionnaire (or a G-Cloud-style spreadsheet) so we can start filling it?

Action items (your side)
- Please confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (name + email).
- Confirm whether you require vendor-held audit logs to be exported or if short-term read-only access during review is OK.

Next meeting
- Suggested: 30-min security touchpoint week of Apr 18 to run through the playbook and procurement path. I pasted a calendar link below.

Thanks — will keep this short and focused.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (1 page, summary of scope & controls)

From: Aisha Narang <aisha@greenfieldhealth.com>

Cc: Lee Procurement <lee.procure@greenfieldhealth.com>, Greenfield Health Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Greenfield Health — recap from today's call and next steps

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary and the SOC2 one-pager. Useful.

Procurement / economic buyer details:
- Economic buyer: Amrita Desai (VP Product), amrita.desai@greenfieldhealth.com
- Procurement lead: Lee (cc'd). She'll own the vendor questionnaire and PO path.

Security specifics we need to validate:
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure read-only link to it).
- Pen test report OR the ability to confirm a third-party pen test is scheduled within the quarter.
- Audit logs: we need to know retention granularity and whether logs can be exported in JSON/CSV for our SIEM.
- Data residency / encryption at rest: confirm default region and KMS options.

Also — we expect a 10–15 page "security playbook" that maps each of our required controls to evidence (e.g., data flow diagrams, who holds keys, data deletion SOPs). Can Marissa produce something like that or point me to a template we can review quickly?

We can do the security touchpoint Apr 19 at 11:00am ET — does that work?

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Clinical Platforms
Greenfield Health

Subject: Re: Greenfield Health — security playbook + evidence list

Hi Aisha / Vivek — looping in the security/product folks to make this concrete. Short answers up front, then what we'll send by EOD: 

Quick answers
- SOC 2: We can provide a secured link to our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (scope: platform + hosted inference runtime). We cannot attach the full report in-thread; will share via restricted Drive link with watermarking.
- Pen test: We completed an external pen test last quarter; full remediation tracker is available. If Greenfield requires a pen-test with Greenfield scope, we can run an engagement with our third-party assessor (timeline ~4–6 weeks).
- Audit logs: We retain request-level audit logs 90 days by default; enterprise customers can opt into 365-day retention and S3 export in JSON format. Logs include request timestamp, model id, token counts, and routing decisions (no customer prompt content unless explicitly enabled under contract).
- Data residency: Default region is us-west-2; customer-managed KMS options are available for Private deployments.

What I'll attach now:
- security-playbook-brief.pdf (3 pages, maps key control families to evidence types)
- pen-test-scope.xlsx (stub with example scope & timeline)

Next steps from our side
1) I'll share the secure SOC2 link once procurement confirms the list of recipients (Lee + Amrita).
2) If you need a tailored pen-test, we can draft a statement of work and timeline; otherwise we'll provide the remediation tracker from our last test.
3) Proposed security touchpoint: Apr 19 at 11:00am ET (I can host). Vivek — can you send a calendar invite with meeting notes template?

If helpful, below is a one-paragraph excerpt we often include in vendor questionnaires (feel free to paste into your spreadsheet):
"Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage for the hosted inference control environment. Audit scope covers compute, network, and logical access controls; third-party dependencies are assessed annually. Audit reports are provided to customers under NDA. For detailed control mapping, see security-playbook-brief.pdf."

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: security-playbook-brief.pdf, pen-test-scope.xlsx
